## How it works

<h2>BIM workflow</h2><p>Choose any storey returned by the model. The lowest storey opens first. Each button restores a top-down floor slice; pan and zoom to inspect the plan. The left toolbar's Sections panel shows the recognized storey and cut. Select a component and click 1 element selected at the top left to open Properties.</p>
<h2>Developer integration</h2><p>An integration supplies each saved floor plan as a downward BCF camera and two horizontal clipping bounds. The page queries storey names and placements through <code>viewer.IfcAPI</code>. Cuts retain 0.30 m below each queried elevation and 1.50 m above it. <code>bcf.save()</code>, <code>viewer.add()</code> and <code>viewer.selectTopic()</code> handle the saved views; the model is imported once and plan changes select an existing topic.</p><p>Copy this folder and serve it over HTTP, for example <code>python -m http.server 8080</code>. Open <code>http://localhost:8080/</code>; the SDK and sample downloads require internet access.</p>
<p>The page opens the original source bytes with <code>await viewer.IfcAPI</code>, reads native model data, then closes the model and disposes WASM before displaying the source with <code>viewer.add()</code>. See the <a href="https://thatopen.github.io/engine_web-ifc/docs/classes/web-ifc.IfcAPI.html">complete web-ifc API reference</a>.</p>
